title: Kazy with Noodles
description: A traditional dish from Kazakhstan, centered on horse meat, all-purpose flour, chicken egg, yellow onion. A measured home-kitchen version organized by cooking step. Kazy-inspired sliced boiled horse meat rather than genuine horse sausage; the catalog lacks prepared kazy and sausage casings.

steps.instruction: Simmer horse meat gently in salted water until safely cooked through; genuine kazy is a specific cured horse sausage, not reproduced here.
Mix the dough ingredients, knead until smooth and elastic, then cover and rest for about 15 minutes.
Add the listed ingredients to the pot. Keep at a gentle simmer for about 13 minutes, until tender and cooked through.
Assemble the cooled components with the listed fillings or toppings. Refrigerate briefly if needed to set the layers.
